## Pull Request

Discussion: #16362 

## Description

This PR improves typing for `OpenAPI tag metadata` by introducing `TypedDict` definitions for the OpenAPI tag structure.

The goal is to provide better IDE autocomplete and static type checking for fields such as name, description, and `externalDocs`, while preserving backward compatibility with existing code using `list[dict[str, Any]]`.

The parameter accepts both forms:

`list[OpenAPITag] | list[dict[str, Any]] | None`
